w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: They settled names for 6 beasts: "Big Loud", "Ugly-Eyes", "Big-Eyes", "The Loud Beast", "Old Gavel", "The Ugly Beast".

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Focus Group is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Chorus Line is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (The Terms of Service, Buffering, The Callback, Ad Break) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🩸 The Callback mauled Daniyar (-35 health) over 2 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing. — staying out of sight for the rest of the day — too hurt to meet it again

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Ad Break.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Big Ugly." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +2077 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (15/13/7), with 3 wave-4 fought, 8 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 34 → 24 · capped · Craft 16 · Talk 16 · Explore 28 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Rafael Ayala ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

◈ THE PANTHEON — Rafael Ayala and Ruby Callaghan ascended together, and gods, it turns out, have politics. They argue about you the way the living argue about weather. Mostly, they agree: the village comes first. Mostly.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

hurtreturn.line: 🧭 Ruby returns from the wilds hurt (health 6/100) — the trip cut short.
